page.notes: Greek word at the start of the left column (ὁμοούσιον) is uncertain; the final letter is doubtful. Where the printed long s looks like f, it is read as s (for example "fynagogas," "suum"). Consonantal u was changed to v (for example "venia," "verbum"). "ucntus" was read as "ventus," and "ver." in "ucr." is an abbreviation not fully clear. The entry "contra tyrannos ... 21.b.23.a" has uncertain digits at the start of the page reference. Wrapped entries were joined into one line each. "uaticinium Iacobi de Simsone" is printed on the continuation line of the V entry at the right. Page signature is partly obscured.
